# Roles and policies of sevenx_multisite

This page is for administrators who manage users on a `sevenx_multisite` installation and want to know what the
install gave each role, and for developers who change it. It answers: which roles get which policies, which sections
and user groups are created, and who is assigned to what. The general guide to roles is
[Roles and policies](../../../guides/roles-and-policies.md).

## Contents

1. [Two places that write roles](#two-places-that-write-roles)
2. [Sections and user groups](#sections-and-user-groups)
3. [Anonymous](#anonymous)
4. [Member](#member)
5. [Editor](#editor)
6. [Partner](#partner)
7. [Role assignments](#role-assignments)
8. [Administrator preferences](#administrator-preferences)

## Two places that write roles

| Where | When it runs | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `siteRoles()`, called through `eZSiteRoles()` in `roles.php` | while `CreateSites` sets up roles | returns role definitions the setup applies |
| `initSteps()` steps 16 to 31 | in the post-install | kernel steps `createContentSection`, `addPoliciesForRole`, `removePoliciesForRole`, `createContentObject`, `setSection`, `renameContentObject`, `assignUserToRole` |

`addPoliciesForRole` creates the role when it does not exist yet (`create_role` defaults to `true` in
`kernel/classes/ezsiteinstaller.php`), so the Partner role is created by its first policy. The Administrator role
is not changed by the installer; it already has `*/*`.

Policies are limited by class and section. In the step list a class or section is given by identifier or name and
resolved when the step runs (`classIDbyIdentifier`, `sectionIDbyName`), so the policies refer to the ids of the new
installation.

## Sections and user groups

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `createContentSection` | a section "Restricted" with the navigation part `ezcontentnavigationpart` |
| `createContentObject` | a `user_group` "Partners" below `users` |
| `setSection` | `users/partners` in the Restricted section |
| `setSection` | `x_archives`, "the top-level Archives folder of the base data", in the Restricted section; skipped when it does not exist |
| `renameContentObject` | object 11, "Guest accounts", renamed to "Members" |

## Anonymous

| Module / function | Limitation | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `rss/feed` | | `siteRoles()`, assigned to the guest and anonymous accounts |
| `user/login` | `SiteAccess`: every served siteaccess except the admin and adminui | `siteRoles()` |
| `content/read` | `Section` 3 (Media), so images embedded in article bodies render | `siteRoles()` |
| `tags/view` | | `siteRoles()`: tag links of articles and recipes |
| `info-collection/read` | | `siteRoles()`: the lead form modal of the Bold templates |
| `shop/buy` | | post-install |
| `content/create` | classes `comment` and `review`, section Standard, language the primary language | post-install |
| `ezjscore/call` | `FunctionList` `ezstarrating_rate`, `ezstarrating_user_has_rated`, `loadMore` | post-install |
| `content/read` | classes `image`, `banner`, `flash`, `real_video`, `windows_media`, `quicktime`, `video`, section Media | post-install |

The login policy lists `bold` and `bold_ger` too: "Without bold and bold_ger here the Bold site refuses anonymous
access even once the siteaccesses are registered."

## Member

| Module / function | Limitation |
|---|---|
| `content/read` | `Section` 3 |
| `tags/view`, `info-collection/read` | |
| `content/create` | `forum_topic` below `forum`, section Standard |
| `content/create` | `forum_reply` below `forum_topic`, section Standard |
| `content/create` | `comment` below `article`, `blog_post` or `article_mainpage`, section Standard |
| `content/edit` | `comment`, `forum_topic`, `forum_reply`, section Standard, `Owner` self |
| `user/selfedit`, `user/password`, `notification/use`, `ezjscore/call` | |
| `user2fa/setup`, `user2fa/verify` | only when `sevenx_authentication_2fa` is installed |

## Editor

The post-install first removes the Editor role's `content/*` policy, then adds:

| Module / function | Limitation |
|---|---|
| `content/create` | 24 classes (`folder`, `link`, `file`, `product`, `feedback_form`, `frontpage`, the three article classes, `blog`, `poll`, `multicalendar`, `documentation_page`, `infobox`, the media classes, `gallery`, `forum`, `forums`, `event_calendar`, `banner`, `image`) below a `folder` |
| `content/create` | `blog_post` below `blog`; `forum_topic` below `forum`; `event` below `event_calendar`; `image` below `gallery` |
| `content/create` | `folder`, `link`, `feedback_form`, `frontpage`, `documentation_page`, `gallery`, `event_calendar`, `multicalendar`, `forums` below a `frontpage` |
| `websitetoolbar/use` | 24 classes |
| `content/edit` | |
| `content/read` | sections Standard, Restricted and Media |
| `notification/use`, `content/manage_locations`, `ezodf/*`, `content/diff`, `content/versionread`, `content/versionremove`, `content/remove`, `content/translate`, `rss/feed`, `content/bookmark`, `content/pendinglist`, `content/dashboard`, `content/view_embed` | |
| `uiswitch/language`, `uiswitch/design` | the interface language and design choices of the admin toolbar |
| `ezjscore/call` | `FunctionList` `ezjscnode`, the node data calls of the sub-items list and the online editor |
| `user2fa/setup`, `user2fa/verify` | only when `sevenx_authentication_2fa` is installed |

> **Note**
> The `content/create` limitations of the Editor role name the classes of `sevenx_classes`, not the `ng_*` classes of
> the demo content. Check the role before giving editors the Fit & Healthy and Bold Agency content to work on.

## Partner

| Module / function | Limitation |
|---|---|
| `content/read` | section Restricted |
| `content/create` | `forum_topic` below `forum`, `forum_reply` below `forum_topic`, `comment` below `article`, all in section Restricted |
| `content/edit` | `comment`, `forum_topic`, `forum_reply`, section Restricted, `Owner` self |
| `user/selfedit`, `notification/use` | |
| `user2fa/setup`, `user2fa/verify` | only when `sevenx_authentication_2fa` is installed |

## Role assignments

| User group | Roles |
|---|---|
| `users/members` (the renamed "Guest accounts") | Member |
| `users/partners` | Partner, Member, Anonymous |
| `users/editors` | Member |
| the guest and anonymous accounts | Anonymous (from `siteRoles()`) |

## Administrator preferences

`sitePreferences()` sets these preferences for the administrator account (the object with remote id
`1bb4fe25487f05527efa8bfd394cecc7` in the setup's object map):

| Preference | Value |
|---|---|
| `admin_navigation_content` | `1` |
| `admin_navigation_roles` | `1` |
| `admin_navigation_policies` | `1` |
| `admin_list_limit` | `2` (the comment in the code: "The child list limit is 25 by default") |
| `admin_treemenu` | `1` |
| `admin_bookmark_menu` | `1` |
